name: dcr_display
description: Display, menu, and screen-management library for ESP32. Panel-agnostic drawing facade with TFT_eSPI, Adafruit ILI9341, and U8g2 (monochrome) backends.
comment: Panel libraries are deliberately NOT dependencies. Each driver is guarded by
__has_include, so add only the one your board needs to your own lib_deps:
Declaring them here would make every project download all three.
